reason: Adds a render_flowchart tool that converts supported Mermaid flowchart documents into themed, self-contained SVG files through the Harness write tool.

summaries.zh: 将支持的 Mermaid 流程图源码渲染为带主题的自包含 SVG，并通过 Harness 的写入工具保存到指定路径。
summaries.en: Renders supported Mermaid flowchart source into themed, self-contained SVG files and saves them through the Harness write tool.

capabilities: Converts Mermaid flowchart source into themed SVG output
Delegates SVG file creation to the existing Harness write tool
Supports configurable themes, spacing, transparency, and output limits
